item.title: Fort Carson opens new fire station
item.description: (FORT CARSON, Colo.) — On Wednesday, Feb. 18, Fort Carson Fire and Emergency Services celebrated the opening of its brand new fire station. Fire Station 34 is a new 8,000 square-foot facility, located near Gate 6 along Wilderness Road, which replaces the previous Station 34 located at the Turkey Creek Recreational Center. item.title: Collaboration attributed to swift response following deadly crash
item.description: (PUEBLO, Colo.) — Emergency dispatchers in Pueblo County coordinated a response from 23 different agencies Tuesday morning following a deadly pileup on I-25. item.title: State lawmakers consider ways to prevent domestic violence deaths
item.description: With domestic violence deaths on the rise in Colorado, state lawmakers are considering a statewide protocol for assessing a victim's risk of being killed.
